purpose: Run the separate-process CUDA-IPC S2 endpoint and both strong local baselines on one node, one allocation, one MPS epoch, and the exact same deterministic radio trace.

endpoint.transport: same-device CUDA IPC with request-specific PUSCH/channel estimate and output LLR
endpoint.lifecycle: persistent for the external timed epoch; teardown only after its final release

execution.operational_requalification: 200-release independent-seed conventional smoke; excluded from comparison statistics

interpretation_limit: This gate compares radio utility and executed conventional work. It does not yet measure background throughput concurrent with the external endpoint, and a measured zero-miss run is not a mathematical WCET proof.
